question: What are the evaluation criteria and their weights used in Level IV of the LACERS 2025 actuarial consulting services RFP?
expected_facts: Professionalism 15; Proposed Scope of Services Description and Methodology 30; Qualifications, Experience, and Accomplishments 35; Value of Cost 20; Total 100.
acceptance: Professionalism15, proposed scope/method30, qualifications/experience35, value/cost20. Points or percentages accepted because weights total100.
